Frequently Asked Questions

How old is T.J. McConnell?

T.J. McConnell is 34 years old.

Where was T.J. McConnell born?

T.J. McConnell was born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

When was T.J. McConnell born?

T.J. McConnell was born on March 25, 1992.

How tall is T.J. McConnell?

T.J. McConnell is 6-1 (185 cm) tall.

How much does T.J. McConnell weigh?

T.J. McConnell weighs 190 lbs (86 kg).

Is T.J. McConnell in the Hall of Fame?

T.J. McConnell is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position does T.J. McConnell play?

Point Guard.

What is T.J. McConnell's net worth?

T.J. McConnell has made at least $55,271,631 playing professional basketball.

How much does T.J. McConnell make?

T.J. McConnell made $10,200,000 in 2026.

How many rings does T.J. McConnell have?

T.J. McConnell has won 0 championships.

What is T.J. McConnell's Instagram account?

T.J. McConnell is on Instagram at tjmcconnell.

What schools did T.J. McConnell attend?

T.J. McConnell attended Chartiers Valley in Bridgeville, Pennsylvania, Duquesne and Arizona.

What are T.J. McConnell's nicknames?

Floor General, McClutchell, Rocco, Great White Hope are nicknames for T.J. McConnell.
